Name: Place Floor on Tilled Dirt
Author: temisthem
Description:
[b][size=4]You can place flooring on tilled dirt!

You can place flooring on untilled dirt!

No, that doesn't mean you can place flooring on tilled dirt that has crops on it.
[/size][/b]
[size=3]I just got iridium sprinklers in my current playthrough and I got tired of destroying tilled soil just to place flooring on it.

I recommend using this with gaussfire's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9344]Faster Path Speed [/url]for its built in path replacement. You can place a path on an existing path with it.

[b][size=6]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)

[size=6][b]Mod Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
This mod is limitless. Nothing can stop it. And it's also kind enough to play nicely with other mods too!

[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Whoever has this installed can place flooring on tilled soil. 

[b][size=6]Configuration:[/size]
[/b]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
Customizable settings include:
- Enabling and disabling the mod
[/size]
